issues.detail: The Greek 'ως πιστω κτιστη' (as faithful builders) is rendered in Vietnamese as 'thành tín' (faithful/trustworthy). This changes the grammatical role of 'faithful' from an attributive description of the 'builders' to a state or quality. More importantly, it loses the specific metaphor of 'builders' (κτιστη), which is essential to the imagery of the verse.
